common.tagline: Chennai civic issue reporter & accountability tracker
common.unverified: Unverified — confirm before relying on this
common.estimatedNotGuaranteed: Estimated target, not a guaranteed deadline

home.heroTitle: See it. Report it. Track it.
home.heroSubtitle: An independent, citizen-run tracker for civic issues in Chennai — not a government app.
home.disclaimer: Ooru Kural is an independent accountability layer. It is not run by, and does not speak for, any government agency.

emergency.title: This looks like an emergency
emergency.body: If anyone is in immediate danger, call for help now instead of filing a report.
emergency.continueToReport: This is not an emergency — continue to a normal report
emergency.verifiedNote: Verified against an official source on {date}.
emergency.unverifiedNote: Reported by third-party sources, not yet confirmed on the agency's own site — call 112 if unsure.

capture.photoWarningMismatchLocation: This photo's location looks far from your pin. Is that right?
capture.photoWarningOld: This photo looks old. Reports work best with a photo taken right now.
capture.photoWarningScreenshot: This looks like a screenshot, not a camera photo.
capture.blurHint: Drag a box over any face or number plate before submitting — we also strip hidden location data from the photo.
capture.addYourVoice: Add your voice instead of filing a new report
capture.categoryTitle: What kind of problem is this?
capture.categoryEditHint: This is a suggestion, not a verdict — change it if it's wrong.
capture.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Large pothole in the middle of the road, has been there two weeks.
capture.sensitiveLocation: This is near a private home — fuzz the exact location on the public map
capture.offlineQueued: You're offline. This report is saved on your device and will send automatically once you're back online.
capture.submitError: Couldn't submit — saved to your offline queue instead.

routing.title: Who handles this
routing.chooseLikelyOwner: Ownership isn't certain — choose the most likely agency

filing.title: File this with {agency}
filing.referenceNumberPlaceholder: Paste the reference number once you get one

verification.title: Is it actually fixed?
verification.promptBody: Take a new photo from the same spot so we can check it's really fixed.
verification.mismatchWarning: This photo appears to be from a different place than the original report.

escalation.title: Escalate
escalation.sendPrompt: This issue is overdue. Ready to escalate?
escalation.groupAction: Combine with other nearby issues into one request

wardDashboard.title: {ward} dashboard
wardDashboard.methodologyNote: These are citizen-reported figures, not official statistics — see methodology and caveats below.

offlinePage.title: You're offline
offlinePage.body: Some features need a connection. Reports you've started are saved and will sync automatically.

footer.notGovernment: Ooru Kural is an independent project and is not affiliated with Greater Chennai Corporation, Metro Water, TANGEDCO, or any government body.
